Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in data interpretation and synthesis. In Step 3, the Planner incorrectly concluded that "Dilan 1991" was released in 1991 based on the film's title, despite the WebSurfer results in Step 2 explicitly stating the film is a "2019 Indonesian language romantic drama film" and listing a release date of "February 28, 2019" on IMDb. The Planner failed to distinguish between the title's reference to the year 1991 (the setting of the story) and the actual release date of the movie, leading to the false conclusion that Dilan 1991 (1991) came out before Celine: Through The Eyes Of The World (2010).
